title: Reserve Bank of India issues Consolidated Supervisory Directions
description: The Reserve Bank has constantly endeavoured to refine and strengthen its regulatory and supervisory framework with a view, inter alia, to rationalising the requirements and minimising compliance costs through periodic evaluation for their continued relevance. 2.
